controls.summary: Use the device editor for operating rules and machine interactions; movement remains available. Escape pauses.

objective: Find 1 key(s), open the east chamber, collect 1 relic(s), activate 3 ordered switches, then reach the exit.
title: Relicbound Adventure
subtitle: The Compiler Catacombs
learning_objectives: Learn the platform controls, missions and progression.
Discuss the institute and college VMGO, PILOs and CILOs using instructor-provided statements.
win_condition: Operate the mission's required device ports using the instruction editor, then: Recover the required relics, unlock the chamber, complete its processes and reach the exit.
lose_condition: Your explorer loses all health or the 600-second time limit expires before completion.
hint: Program the controller, run it, inspect the live input/output and revise rejected operations. INTERACT requires an eligible nearby port.
